notes.title: Infected – Full Release is Here! 🎮
notes.content:
[h1]Survivors, the wait is over! Infected has officially reached its final release and is now available for download on Steam!
Get ready to step into a harsh post-apocalyptic world where a deadly virus has transformed much of the population into terrifying infected zombies. You'll need every ounce of your skill, strategy, and firepower to survive.[/h1]

notes.title: New Discord Page
notes.content: Hey everyone! I'm excited to announce that I've just opened a Discord page for Infected development. If you're interested in following the game's progress, discussing ideas, or just hanging out with other players, be sure to join us. Here's the link to the server: https://discord.gg/BRsxNN8Y. Looking forward to seeing you there!

notes.title: INFECTED NEWS
notes.content:
Dear Infected players,

We wanted to take a moment to update you on the next steps for Infected. First of all, we want to thank you for your continued support and feedback, which has been invaluable in helping us shape the game.

We understand that some players may feel that the game is not yet ready for purchase, and we want to assure you that you can still support the development of Infected by adding it to your wishlist on Steam. This is a great way to let us know that you are interested in the game and would like to see it improve over time.

For those of you who have already purchased Infected, we are excited to announce that after finishing the campaign, you will have access to a new main hub map where you can take on new assignments, missions, and use a fire range to hone your skills.

Furthermore, we have a major update coming soon that we believe will greatly enhance the game and provide an even more enjoyable experience for players. We can't reveal all the details just yet, but we think you'll be pleased with what's in store.

Once again, thank you for your support and stay tuned for more updates on Infected.

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that our new game "Infected" is now available in Early Access on Steam! Get ready to experience an action-packed survival game like never before. To celebrate the release, we are offering a special launch discount of 20% on all purchases made before April 25th, 2023.
 In Infected, you will find yourself stranded in a post-apocalyptic world where a deadly virus has turned most of the population into zombie-like creatures. Your mission is to survive against all odds, and you will need to scavenge for resources, and fight off hordes of infected and other human enemies.
 Don't miss out on this thrilling adventure! Head over to our Steam page and get your copy of Infected today while the discount lasts. We can't wait to see you in the game!

notes.title: Infected Demo Released
notes.content: [h1]We are thrilled to announce that the demo for our game Infected is now available on Steam! This is your chance to experience the world of Infected, where you'll battle against hordes of zombies and fight for your survival in a post-apocalyptic world.[/h1]
